title: Design exercise: SAA-3.4-S03
scenario: Tenmouth Post-Production edits broadcast footage in a city-centre studio whose editing workstations need a round trip of 8 ms or less to the GPU render hosts and shared storage they use, while the nearest standard Region is about 40 ms away; AWS confirms a metro-area extension of that Region exists in the studio's city. The firm also runs camera vehicles whose on-board devices connect only over a mobile carrier's 5G network, and their live-scoring app must respond within 12 ms end to end without its traffic leaving the carrier's network; the carrier hosts AWS infrastructure inside that network. Finally, the asset-management database holds contracts, has no latency target tighter than 50 ms and must never be reachable from the internet.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
Workloads without a stated latency target must use ordinary Region capacity; finance will not pay for edge placement that no figure justifies
The asset database must survive the loss of one Availability Zone
Editing workstations and the compute and storage they use must be in the same metropolitan area

rubric.label: The editing compute and storage sit where the round trip is 8 ms or less, and the vehicle app's traffic stays inside the carrier's network within 12 ms
The asset database has no internet route and is spread over two Availability Zones in a standard Region, and nothing else is placed at the edge
